sn35.55:1.6: And also knowing and seeing the pleasant, painful, or neutral feeling that arises dependent on eye contact as not-self, the fetters are uprooted.
sn35.55:1.15: And also knowing and seeing the pleasant, painful, or neutral feeling that arises dependent on mind contact as not-self, the fetters are uprooted.
sn35.55:1.16: That’s how to know and see so that the fetters are uprooted.”
